prompts.text: # Fix a failing AXF Dev Console systems check: Console public URL set The console's systems check reported this, and its automatic fix failed. Fix the cause, then re-check. - Check id: `routine:env-public-url` (service console, status warn) - What it says: AXF_PUBLIC_URL isn't set - How the fix failed: You don't have to do it by hand. Run both from an axHub-connected Mosses session (the console's Mosses chat, which has `axhub_call`) and they'll come to you as two approvals. Details: - Alerts and push notifications use it to link back to the console, so links come out empty without it. - env {…
prompts.output: The warning is fixed on the live console, but the permanent fix couldn't be pushed — GitHub rejected the credentials. **What was wrong:** the console isn't a Coolify app. It's a plain `docker run` started by `deploy/install-console.sh`, and that script never passed `AXF_PUBLIC_URL` to the container…
